svg.title: Становая тяга с широким хватом — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. A wide snatch-grip barbell DEADLIFT, not a snatch pull. One long straight barbell with clearly very widely spaced hands, both hands close to sleeves and much wider than shoulders. Front three-quarter view. LEFT: plates on floor, hips and knees bent, spine neutral, both heels and forefeet contact floor, elbows straight. RIGHT: standing erect with knees and hips extended, bar at upper thighs, arms straight, shoulders relaxed, BOTH HEELS DOWN, no shrug or jumping. Same grip and feet in both phases. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
